newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.060pts to 100.532.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.060pts to 100.532.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.060 points in Tuesday's trading to 100.532, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.555 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.023 points to 96.729, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.331 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 1.395 points to 1,152.131.
